text:
Alex K: morning — heads up, I'm seeing a handful of H100 allocations in us-west2 show `SOFT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` right as the demo burst starts. anyone else? :eyes:
Priya S: yep saw it ~10m ago, cloud support opened a ticket. their message says a regional enforcement window, possibly a banked quota rebalancing. link they gave: https://provider.status/incidents/12345
Mateo R: also got alerts from the allocator that spot pools were getting evicted. autoscaler started draining a couple nodes. logs show: `pod eviction due to insufficient gpu_quota`
capacity-bot: Alert: 1768034575 - region us-west2: H100 quota usage 110% (soft limit). Recommended action: fallback to compatible SKUs or schedule burst to different region.
Jenna L: we have a quick fallback path in the autoscaler PR (https://git/repo/pull/987) to prefer A100 pool if H100 unavailable. it's unmerged but small. i can cut a hotfix if we need to flip today. :+1:
Alex K: what's the impact on latency for the demo if we route to A100? rough numbers ok.
Mateo R: 5-10% slower on reproduction tests for the <2048 token paths. cost ~1.2x/token vs H100 but stable. for the burst size we should be fine.
Priya S: recommend two-step: (1) manual canary -> point 10% traffic to A100, (2) if stable, update routing policy to prefer A100 for new sessions. i can run the canary @ 09:40 PT.
Alex K: sounds good. Mateo, can you prepare a quick runbook? last time we had to update the route table and kick the prefix cache.
Mateo R: will do. adding the little script here to switch route weight (run from infra-admin):
```
# switch 20% traffic to a100 pool
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/update -d '{"region":"us-west2","weights":{"h100":80,"a100":20}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Jenna L: PR 987 includes an automated fallback flag (`prefer_compatible: true`) that authors the same change programmatically. if we need it faster i can merge and release the change in the next 15m.
Priya S: can you hold off on the full merge until after the canary? i want to validate the logs for kv-cache behavior (last time we saw a regen spike).
Jenna L: yep holding. i'll branch a hotfix if we need an emergency flip.
Alex K: ok plan: Priya runs canary at 09:40 PT, Mateo runs the route script and monitors token latency/billing, Jenna stands by to merge hotfix if regen spike > 15% or error rate increases. i'll notify demo owners. any objections?
Mateo R: no objections. i'll document steps in the runbook and paste back a link.
capacity-bot: Info: 1768034810 - Ticket #CLOUD-789 opened with provider. ETA update expected within 30-60m.
Priya S: on it. will post results and the log snippet after the canary. :binoculars:
Alex K: thanks all — appreciate the quick sync. :rocket:
